headline: Crude bomb explodes in front of old Ramna Police Station
summary: An improvised explosive device detonated outside the old Ramna Police Station on Bailey Road. Police are reviewing CCTV footage to identify the perpetrators.
details: A crude bomb exploded in front of the old Ramna Police Station on Bailey Road in Dhaka on Friday night. The incident occurred around 8 PM.
According to Sheikh Jahidul Islam, deputy commissioner of the Ramna Division police, two individuals on a motorcycle threw the explosive device before fleeing the scene.
Police have launched an investigation and are examining CCTV footage to identify the suspects involved in the incident.

topic: fire breaks out at cox's bazar hotel
headline_marked: [[Fire breaks out at Cox's Bazar hotel]] just a week after deadly blaze
headline: Fire breaks out at Cox's Bazar hotel just a week after deadly blaze
summary: Around 300 tourists evacuated a star hotel in Cox's Bazar after a fire erupted from a generator short circuit. The blaze was brought under control within 30 minutes.
details: A fire broke out at the star hotel The Sea Prince in Cox's Bazar's Sugandha Point on Friday afternoon. The incident occurred just seven days after a fire at the Toptop Resort on Marine Drive claimed 10 lives.
The fire originated from a generator short circuit in the hotel's ground-floor parking area. Around 300 tourists staying at the hotel quickly evacuated to the adjacent beach.
Firefighters and hotel authorities worked together to control the blaze, bringing it under control within approximately 30 minutes. Fortunately, no casualties were reported in this incident.
caption:
Fire erupts at a star hotel in Cox's Bazar, forcing hundreds of tourists to evacuate.
This comes just a week after a deadly blaze elsewhere in the popular tourist town.

A fire broke out at the star hotel The Sea Prince in Cox's Bazar's Sugandha Point on Friday afternoon. The incident occurred just seven days after a fire at the Toptop Resort on Marine Drive claimed 10 lives.

The fire originated from a generator short circuit in the hotel's ground-floor parking area. Around 300 tourists staying at the hotel quickly evacuated to the adjacent beach.

Firefighters and hotel authorities worked together to control the blaze, bringing it under control within approximately 30 minutes. Fortunately, no casualties were reported in this incident.
